title: Argo Rollouts / Operations
description: Curated health view of Argo Rollouts in the homelab: is the controller up, are Rollouts and their canary analyses healthy, is the controller keeping up. Built from the Argo Rollouts v1.10.2 controller metrics docs (https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md), the metric definitions in controller/metrics and the upstream example dashboard ('Argo Rollouts / Official').

panels.title: How to read this dashboard
panels.description: Reading guide for this dashboard.

options.content:
**What Argo Rollouts does here.** Argo Rollouts v1.10.2 (chart 2.43.12, namespace `argo-rollouts`, one controller
replica) replaces a Deployment by a `Rollout` that ships a new version as a canary or blue-green, shifting traffic on the
shared Gateway through the Gateway API plugin and checking it with Prometheus **ClusterAnalysisTemplates**
(`success-rate`, `p95-latency`, `pod-restarts`, in argo-rollouts-raw). Rollouts are seen and promoted from Argo CD
(rollout extension); there is no standalone Rollouts dashboard.

**Today no Rollout exists**, so every per-Rollout panel (phase, replicas, AnalysisRuns, reconcile latency) is empty by
design: the controller only exports `rollout_*`, `analysis_run_*` and `experiment_*` series for existing objects. What is
live now: controller up/version, the AnalysisTemplates, workqueues, Kubernetes API calls, resources.

**Healthy looks like:** controller UP, no Rollout in Error/Abort/Timeout/InvalidSpec, 0 reconcile errors, workqueues near 0.
**When something is red:** `kubectl --context k8s01 argo rollouts get rollout <name> -n <ns>` (or the Argo CD UI),
`kubectl --context k8s01 -n argo-rollouts logs deploy/argo-rollouts` (json logs), and the AnalysisRun of the failed step:
`kubectl --context k8s01 -n <ns> get analysisruns`. The Rollout's namespace is the label `exported_namespace`
(`namespace` is the controller's, set by the scrape).

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

panels.title: Controller
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape the Rollouts controller (:8090, 1 = up). Down = no Rollout progresses or aborts. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md. Derived query: Prometheus `up` of the scrape job.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Controller version from `argo_rollouts_controller_info` (must match the pin v1.10.2 in helm-charts/argo-rollouts/helmfile.yaml.gotmpl). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/controller/metrics/prommetrics.go.

panels.title: Rollouts
panels.description: Rollout objects known to the controller (`rollout_info` = 1 per Rollout). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json ("Total Rollouts").

panels.title: Failed rollouts
panels.description: Rollouts whose phase is Error, Abort, Timeout or InvalidSpec (alert `ArgoRolloutFailed`). Phases are computed in controller/metrics/rollouts.go from the Progressing/InvalidSpec conditions. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json (Error/Timeout/Aborted/Invalid Spec stats).

panels.title: Paused
panels.description: Rollouts waiting at a pause step (manual promotion or timed pause). Normal during a canary. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json.

panels.title: Progressing
panels.description: Rollouts currently shifting traffic or scaling a new ReplicaSet. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json.

panels.title: Analysis templates
panels.description: AnalysisTemplates + ClusterAnalysisTemplates seen by the controller (`analysis_template_info`; 3 ClusterAnalysisTemplates in argo-rollouts-raw). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/controller/metrics/prommetrics.go.

panels.title: Reconcile errors (24h)
panels.description: Errors while reconciling Rollouts, AnalysisRuns and Experiments (`*_reconcile_error` counters, which only appear after the first error). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md.

panels.title: Rollouts
panels.description: One row per Rollout: strategy (canary/blueGreen), traffic router (here the Gateway API plugin) and phase (Completed = healthy and fully promoted). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md (`rollout_info`).

targets.expr: max by (exported_namespace, name, strategy, traffic_router, phase) (rollout_info{job="argo-rollouts-metrics"})

panels.title: Replicas per Rollout
panels.description: Desired vs available vs unavailable replicas (`rollout_info_replicas_*`). Unavailable > 0 for long = new version not becoming ready. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md.

panels.title: Rollout events by reason
panels.description: Kubernetes events emitted by the controller per Rollout (`rollout_events_total`, type Normal/Warning, reason such as RolloutUpdated, RolloutStepCompleted, RolloutAborted). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/controller/metrics/prommetrics.go.

panels.title: Analysis templates and their metrics
panels.description: Each AnalysisTemplate/ClusterAnalysisTemplate and the metrics it checks, with the provider type (prometheus here). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/controller/metrics/prommetrics.go (`analysis_template_metric_info`).

panels.title: AnalysisRuns by phase
panels.description: Existing AnalysisRuns per phase (Pending, Running, Successful, Failed, Error, Inconclusive). A Failed/Error run aborts its Rollout. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md (`analysis_run_info`).

panels.title: AnalysisRun metric results
panels.description: Last result of each metric of each AnalysisRun (`analysis_run_metric_phase` = 1 on the current phase); dry_run = metric does not count toward the verdict. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md.

targets.expr: max by (exported_namespace, name, metric, type, dry_run, phase) (analysis_run_metric_phase{job="argo-rollouts-metrics"} == 1)

panels.title: Reconcile duration (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of one reconcile of a Rollout / AnalysisRun / Experiment (histograms `*_reconcile`, buckets up to 1 s). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md; heatmap "Reconciliation Performance" in https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json.

panels.title: Reconcile errors
panels.description: Reconcile errors per object (alert `ArgoRolloutsReconcileErrors`). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md.

panels.title: Workqueue depth
panels.description: Items waiting per controller queue (Rollouts, AnalysisRuns, Experiments, Services, Ingresses, DestinationRules). Sustained > 0 = controller not keeping up. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md, https://github.com/kubernetes/component-base/blob/master/metrics/prometheus/workqueue/metrics.go.

panels.title: Workqueue wait (p95)
panels.description: Time an item waits in the queue before a worker picks it up (`workqueue_queue_duration_seconds`). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md, https://github.com/kubernetes/component-base/blob/master/metrics/prometheus/workqueue/metrics.go.

panels.title: Work duration (p95)
panels.description: Time a worker spends on one item (`workqueue_work_duration_seconds`). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md, https://github.com/kubernetes/component-base/blob/master/metrics/prometheus/workqueue/metrics.go.

panels.title: Kubernetes API requests by verb and code
panels.description: Requests the controller sends to the API server (`controller_clientset_k8s_request_total`). 4xx/5xx growing = RBAC or API trouble (404 on Get is often normal). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/docs/features/controller-metrics.md.

panels.title: Notifications
panels.description: Notifications sent by the controller (`notification_send_success` / `notification_send_error`). No notification service is configured here, so this stays empty. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/controller/metrics/prommetrics.go.

panels.title: Go heap and goroutines
panels.description: Controller heap in use and goroutines (Go client metrics). Heap is what the upstream dashboard plots as "Memory Used". Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/blob/v1.10.2/examples/dashboard.json.

panels.title: Memory working set vs limit
panels.description: Memory per Argo Rollouts container (solid) and its limit (dashed). Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-monitoring/kubernetes-mixin.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU cores used per Argo Rollouts container. Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-monitoring/kubernetes-mixin.
